title: Re-appointment of Retired Specialists For ESIS Hospitals
organization: Directorate, ESI Labour Medical Services, UP
summary: The Directorate of ESI Labour Medical Services, UP invites applications for the re-appointment of retired specialists against vacant posts in various ESIS hospitals. Eligible retired medical officers can apply through the prescribed format by December 10, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Must be a retired Specialist of ESI Scheme UP or UP Provincial Medical Health services.
Eligible for pension from state government treasury under the old pension scheme.
Maximum age limit is up to 65 years or until regular appointment.

vacancy_breakdown.notes: Includes Physician, Surgeon, Ortho Surgeon, Radiologist, Anesthetist, Chest & TB Specialist, Pathologist, Obs. & Gynae, and Pediatrician across various hospitals.

how_to_apply_steps: Download the application format from http://uplabour.gov.in/ESIS or sewayojan.up.nic.in.
Fill out the application form with all required details and attach necessary documents.
Send the application via registered/speed post or directly to the Directorate, Employee's State Insurance Scheme, Labour Medical Services UP, Sarvodayanagar, Kanpur by the deadline.
